mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 750K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 750K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by > 0.2pp signal improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE declines by > 0.2pp over 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and decreasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a favorable supply-side environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in favorable supply-side environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A spike in retail sales (RSAFS) above $420B signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Dec).
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending indices during holiday seasons
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of holiday season instances when RSAFS > $420B, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive quarterly declines in GDP (GDPC1) by > 1% signal economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDPC1 and economic contraction indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 30% of instances when GDPC1 declines by > 1% over 2 quarters, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong labor market environments are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 signals a favorable supply-side environment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and supply-side confidence indices during non-recessionary periods
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of non-recessionary instances when INDPRO > 95, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
